rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a noticeable characteristic or quality.

example.english: The phone's most useful attribute is its long-lasting battery.
example.traditional: 呢部手機最實用嘅特點係電量好襟用。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 zeoi3 sat6 jung6 ge3 dak6 dim2 hai6 din6 loeng6 hou2 gam1 jung6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when assigning something to a neutral cause or reason.

example.english: The study chooses to attribute the rise in unemployment to the economic slowdown.
example.traditional: 研究選擇將失業率上升歸因於經濟放緩。
example.jyutping: jin4 gau3 syun2 zaak6 zoeng1 sat1 jip6 leot6 soeng6 sing1 gwai1 jan1 jyu1 ging1 zai3 fong3 wun6

rows.note: Choose this when attributing a problem, fault, or bad result to someone or something with blame.

example.english: The company chose to attribute this mistake to a system failure.
example.traditional: 公司將今次失誤歸咎於系統故障。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 zoeng1 gam1 ci3 sat1 ng6 gwai1 gau3 jyu1 hai6 tung2 gu3 zoeng3

rows.note: Use this for a property or attribute belonging to an object, especially in computing or technical contexts.

example.english: Each file has an attribute of its own, such as whether it is read-only or public.
example.traditional: 每個檔案都有自己嘅屬性，例如只讀定公開。
example.jyutping: mui5 go3 dong2 on3 dou1 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 suk6 sing3 lai6 jyu4 zi2 duk6 ding6 gung1 hoi1

rows.note: Use this for an attribute understood specifically as a configurable setting.

example.english: After changing this program's language attribute, you have to reopen it for the change to take effect.
example.traditional: 呢個程式嘅語言設定改咗之後，要重新開先會生效。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cing4 sik1 ge3 jyu5 jin4 cit3 ding6 goi2 zo2 zi1 hau6 jiu3 cung4 san1 hoi1 sin1 wui5 sang1 haau6

rows.note: Use this when the attribute is presented as an available option belonging to an object or system.

example.english: The notification attribute in this system lets you choose whether to turn it on or off.
example.traditional: 呢個系統嘅通知選項可以揀開定關。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 tung2 ge3 tung1 zi1 syun2 hong6 ho2 ji5 gaan2 hoi1 ding6 gwaan1

rows.traditional: 話 A 係 B 寫嘅
rows.jyutping: waa6 A hai6 B se2 ge3
rows.note: Use this natural spoken construction when saying that a work was written by a particular person.

example.english: We attribute this article to Ming as its author.
example.traditional: 我哋話呢篇文章係阿明寫嘅。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 waa6 ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 hai6 aa3 ming4 se2 ge3

rows.note: Use this formal choice when assigning ownership or authorship to a person or group.

example.english: Scholars tend to attribute the authorship of this poem to a young poet.
example.traditional: 學者傾向將呢首詩嘅創作歸於一位年輕詩人。
example.jyutping: hok6 ze2 king1 hoeng3 zoeng1 ni1 sau2 si1 ge3 cong3 zok3 gwai1 jyu1 jat1 wai2 nin4 hing1 si1 jan4
